# openmetadata_prompt_template (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata prompt template. A prompt template stores the text and system prompt used by an AI application or LLM model.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_prompt_template" "ticket_classifier" {
  name             = "ticket-classifier"
  display_name     = "Ticket classifier"
  description      = "Classifies incoming support tickets into a category."
  template_content = "Classify the ticket: {{ticket}}"
  template_type    = "Classification"
  template_version = "1.0"
  system_prompt    = "You are a support agent. Reply with a single category."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Prompt template name. Changing it replaces the template, because the name is the basis of its fully qualified name.
- `template_content` (String) Template body. Placeholders use the OpenMetadata {{variable}} syntax.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the prompt template.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `system_prompt` (String) System prompt sent ahead of the template content.
- `template_type` (String) Template category, for example Classification or ChatCompletion.
- `template_version` (String) Caller-managed template version string.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name. For a prompt template this equals name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_prompt_template.ticket_classifier 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, which for a prompt template is its name.
terraform import openmetadata_prompt_template.ticket_classifier ticket-classifier
```
